properties.notes: P/10734/004. Outline application with all matters reserved for subsequent approval for the construction of 17 no. residential units (8no x one bedroom flats and 8no x two bedrooms flats and one two bedroom dwelling house) comprising the conversion of two existing commercial buildings and the erection of a new building, together with ancillary car parking, landscaping, tree works and vehicular and pedestrian access from Park Street.
